correctness.rationale: The three unit rows form a tight frame sum u_i u_i^T=(3/2)I. Conditional IID means square norm multiplies by a(eta)=1-eta+eta^2/2 per update, hence I_K=a^(3K). Reflection symmetries conjugate all six fixed three-row epoch products; isotropic initial covariance gives S_K=(1/2)||T^K||_F^2, limiting base rho(T)^2 even at a Jordan double root. Independently multiplied exact 2x2 matrices: trT=(eta-2)(eta^2+8eta-8)/8; detT=-(eta-1)^3; discr=eta^4(eta^2+12eta-12)/64. For real eigenvalues, sign comparison reduces to eta^4(eta-2)^2(eta^2-6eta+6)Q(eta)/512, where Q(1+z)=z^2(7z^2-4z+1)+(29z^2-4z+7)>0; unique sign change eta=3-sqrt(3) on 0<eta<2. Exact eta=3/2 checks S1=473/2048<I1=125/512, S2=586697/8388608>I2=15625/262144. Endpoint eta=0,2 excluded; rate equality does not assert finite-epoch equality.
